sections.label: heart
sections.text:
Colds. Alcoholism. Sleeplessness, especially of
alcoholics. Bad effects of Morphine habit. Nervous
states of many female troubles.

sections.label: Mind
sections.text: Inability to keep mind on any one subject.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Nervous headache at menstrual period, witli
burning at top of head. Occipital headache, with phos-
phatic urine.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Amenorrhoea and dysmenorrhcea, with
weak circulation.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Spermatorrhoea ; impotency ; after too much
indulgence.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Numbness of limbs, as if paralyzed.
Strength of hand diminished.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Alfalfa. (General tonic
similar to avena — also in scanty and suppressed urine.)

Dose, — Tincture ten to twenty drop doses, prefei •
ably in hot water.
